# Atardecer Bachata Festival

> Three days of bachata in Valencia. Workshops on the sand and in a seaside pavilion by day, socials with DJs, live acts and shows in a club by night. Beginners are welcome, and the Dominican roots of the dance are part of the programme.

Fictional festival for a course project. 3 days (25-27 June 2027), 3 venues in Valencia, 64 performers, 65 sessions.

## Key pages
- [Programme](https://faiazyen.github.io/web-design-project/web/programme.html): all sessions, filterable by day, venue, type, level, role
- [Performers](https://faiazyen.github.io/web-design-project/web/performers.html): instructors, DJs, bands, singers, show teams
- [Venues](https://faiazyen.github.io/web-design-project/web/venues.html): Arena Stage, Pabellón Brisa, Marea Club, with access facts
- [Tickets](https://faiazyen.github.io/web-design-project/web/tickets.html): four passes, Full Pass EUR 149
- [Practical info](https://faiazyen.github.io/web-design-project/web/practical.html): travel, accommodation, accessibility, FAQ, code of conduct
- [Roots](https://faiazyen.github.io/web-design-project/web/roots.html): story of bachata dominicana

## Facts
- Name: Atardecer Bachata Festival, 1st edition · Primera Ola
- Dates: 2027-06-25 to 2027-06-27
- Location: Valencia, Spain
- Styles: bachata dominicana, bachata sensual, bachata moderna, salsa
- Contact: info@atardecer.example

## Notes
- Every session, performer and venue has its own page with structured data (JSON-LD).
- Accounts and saved sessions are a browser-only demo, not real accounts.
